title.en: An Act Amending Priority Numbered One (Quezon I), Page Seventy-Eight, Appendix B of Republic Act Numbered Sixteen Hundred and Thirteen

text.en:
Priority numbered one (Quezon I), page seventy-eight of Appendix B, Republic Act Numbered Sixteen hundred and thirteen, is hereby amended to read as follows:
"1. Municipal district of Dingalan Central School Construction ₱5,000.00."

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 21, 1957.
